text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After spending a day out together,
Tamamo
Cross and I are headed back to
the academy
when...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I'm gettin' a call... Sorry, could ya
gimme a
minute?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're the manufacturer I ordered
from!
...Huh, whaddya mean, "problem?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's a problem with da product? And
there's
no fixin' it?! Do ya at least have
somethin'
similar?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is a real important present for my li'l
brother!
Check it again for me, wouldja?
Please!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Siiigh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...My li'l bro won a track-and-field
contest, so I
wanted to give him this
okonomiyaki-shaped
cushion he's been
eyein' up.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But the guy just now said there's some
kinda
trouble with their production line,
so they're not
sellin' 'em anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I already told the li'l squirt his
cushion's on
the way... I gotta do
somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Tamamo Cross! You
forgot to
turn in your assignment!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya kiddin' me?! This timin' couldn't be
any
worse... Grk—I'll be back later!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross runs off with a crumpled

expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm desperately racking my brain
for a way
to help her out, a phrase she
recently used pops
into my head.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
When ya don't got it, make it! That's my
fam's
golden rule!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's it! And I know just who to ask for
help with
sewing—Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so you'd like to make a cushion
shaped like
okonomiyaki?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'd be delighted to lend a hand! ♪
I've been
wanting to show Tamtam my
appreciation for all
her help at the farm.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Me too... I haven't sewn much before,
but I'll help
any way I can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of us set about making
the
okonomiyaki-shaped cushion
together.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Why yes, it's the okonomiyaki-shaped
cushion
that your little brother wanted!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Problem solved, right, Tama? I'm glad
things
worked out.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You guys went outta your way to make
this... for
us?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gah, what are ya talkin' 'bout?! It's
perfect!
choice_data_list: It might look a bit clumsy compared to the real thing, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You guys made this thing with love! That
makes it
worth more than anythin' on the
market!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Isn't that nice, Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! That compassion of yours has
gone 'n got
me right in the feels!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've always been the big sibling who
saves the
day, but you're not bad
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've always been the big sibling who
saves the
day, but you're not bad
yourself!
choice_data_list: It's just to return the favor for taking care of me.
I wonder if it turned into a delicious-looking cushion.
Because I want to help Tamamo, too!
Because I want to help Tamamo too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And so did I! ♪ You're always helping me out, Tamtam.
choice_data_list: It's just to return the favor for taking care of me.
I wonder if it turned into a delicious-looking cushion.
Because I want to help Tamamo, too!
Because I want to help Tamamo too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right then, next time's my turn! And I
always
give back double when I'm
repayin' a favor!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well, then I'll have to repay that
favor,
too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa whoa, hold on a sec! You
don't have
to do that—otherwise there'll
be no end to this!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Kind gestures bring about kind
gestures... How
absolutely wonderful. ♪
choice_data_list: I think it'd be good if you helped each other out.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'd love for us to have a connection like
that,
Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That goes for me too. What do you
think, Tama?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Guh! Don't give me the puppy dog
eyes... How am
I s'pposed to say no
now?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay! You scratch my back 'n I'll scratch yours!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, you guys are somethin' else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, through this experience,
Tamamo Cross
comes to develop an
even deeper connection
with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yup, no matter how ya slice it, this is
one
tasty-lookin' okonomiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm hungry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh, a sweet little someone's got a
rumbly
tummy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haha! If you're hungry, I gotcha covered!
choice_data_list: Well, you've been sewing for quite a while...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: As thanks for the cushion, I'll cook up some real okonomiyaki for ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I've sharpened up my skills since
last time, so
you're in for one heck of a
treat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross goes on to cook up
plenty of
okonomiyaki for us all to
enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, ya don't need to get that attached!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We really care about you, Tamtam! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're a very good girl, but you do tend
to try
and manage everything all by
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So we'd like you to come to us for help
from time
to time. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Creek...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I just can't help wanting to spoil
such a
cute, hardworking girl like you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I appreciate it, but I'd rather ya
didn't treat
me like a kid, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sh-she is, huh... Well, I don't see
myself
gettin' used to Creek's
pampering, but I guess it
doesn't feel
half bad.
choice_data_list: It's about honor and heart, not treating you like a kid.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross laughs bashfully, and the
sight
warms my heart.
